g.text: Constraint pairs: certification and flown CRLB
81 episodes per cell · grid certificate at 0.25 m, refined once to 0.125 m
F: certified feasible · I: infeasible on the tested grid · U: search budget exhausted, undecided, not infeasible.
Second line: mean flown event-window CRLB over finite samples; always degenerate: no finite sample in any episode.
*: some episodes flew on the solver's fallback placement, so the value is not the same kind of quality
as in a fully certified cell.
